findings.title: The date-time checker is broader than Draft 2020-12 date-time
findings.detail: datetime.fromisoformat checks parseability and timezone presence but does not enforce the RFC-3339 lexical shape used by JSON Schema date-time. The only committed test uses 'not-a-date-time', so malformed but parseable ISO variants escape the executable contract.
findings.reproduction: Run the verifier edge probe recorded in verification-evidence/independent-probes.json; all three listed invalid strings produce no validation messages.
